scientific_integrity: A direct combinatorial proof covers finite and infinite frames; exact finite checks corroborate but do not prove the general theorem. No independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only finite conjunctions of existential paths to one positive atom over independent reflexive-transitive relations; no modalities requiring universal quantification or other interaction axioms. Historical-priority search is not exhaustive.
source_ids: Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy: Modal Logic
title: Exact witness ranks for multimodal S4 path conjunctions: a subsequence-antichain law
